subtitle: Master the art of syncopation to create rhythmic interest, tension, and groove in your guitar playing.

introduction.title: The Magic of Syncopation
introduction.text: Syncopation creates forward motion and rhythmic tension by placing emphasis on unexpected beats, making music more engaging and dynamic.

columns.title: Rhythmic Interest
columns.text: Syncopation creates forward motion and rhythmic tension by placing emphasis on unexpected beats, making music more engaging and dynamic.

columns.title: Genre Foundation
columns.text: Syncopation is fundamental to many genres including reggae, funk, jazz, and Latin music, each with distinct syncopated characteristics.

cards.title: Off-Beat Emphasis

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: - D - D - D - D

fields.value: Displacement of accent from strong to weak beats
